Messages.Author: hardyrange
Messages.Body:
Hello,

this is to revive the topic.

Supposedly, according to some announcements made on Facebook and Discord, the EC 2024 is planned for 27.-29.09.2024.

But that was it:
There is no information about the venue, no entry in the event calendar or any other official announcement, no website. Thus, no possibility to actually plan something reliably, book travel and hotels, etc.

The players in my group are indeed thinking if they want to skip this EC - although they would very much like to join an event, the lack of communication is felt to be extremely disturbing.

I really hope that something happens soon to address our worries.

Best regards

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
All we have for now is:

tinyurl.com/vtes2024

> Dear All,
>
> Welcome to EC 2024 FAQ document. It is a living document so expect stuff to be added, especially to answer questions that will arise. In any case feel free to email us at
> The updated version of this document is always available here:
> tinyurl.com/vtes2024
>
> Date
> Week of Nightmares: 24-26 of September
> Main EC Event: 27-29 of September
> Location and venue
> Week of Nightmares:
> Hackroom122, Chmielna 122/113 Warsaw
> (52.228344975359285, 20.995591185049413)
>
> Main EC Event:
> Wybrzeże Kościuszkowskie 35, Warsaw
> (52.23837405279206, 21.0318976199684)
>
> Both events will be held in the City Center. If any change would occur (eg. higher demand for Week of Nightmares) we may switch the venue building but we will stick to the city center.
> How to get to Warsaw
> There are few ways to get to Warsaw:
> By plane:
> There are two airports:
> Warsaw Chopin Airport (WAW) - located in Warsaw, about 15 minutes train/car ride to the city center
> Warsaw Modlin Airport (WMI) - located 42 km from Warsaw, it takes about 40 minutes by car or about an hour by bus
> By car: The A2 highway is the easiest way to get to Warsaw.
> By train: There are three main stations in Warsaw- Warsaw Central, Warsaw East and Warsaw West. Due to some construction work some trains may also go to Warsaw Gdańska station - it’s still in the city center, 5 minutes from the tube station.
>
> Getting around the city
> Warsaw has awesome public transport infrastructure, with trams, tube, trains and buses.
> Single ticket costs around 1 EUR, and the cost of three day ticket is about 12 EUR.
> More information can be found here: www.wtp.waw.pl/en/public-transport-step-by-step/
> If you come to Warsaw by car, it’s worth considering to leave the car at the parking lot and move around the city using public transport.
>
> Apart from that there are also taxis:
> - FreeNow
> - iTaxi
> - Uber
> and many more
>
> Hotels and accommodation
> We are talking with some hotels regarding discounts for VTES players. I’ll update the list soon.
>
> Tickets
> The tickets will go on sale in few days:
> EC ticket - 75 EUR
> Week of Nightmares ticket: TBA
>
Prince of Paris, France
